en_title: ‘Maybe We’ve Gone a Step Too Far’ — Ocarina of Time Remake Producer Reveals the Game's ReDeads Were Originally Supposed to Be Even Scarier
cn_title: 「也许我们做得有些过头了」——《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版制作人透露，游戏中的ReDead原本要恐怖得多
opus_summary: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版制作人藤林秀麿表示，画面升级让ReDead的声音、外观和动作一度变得非常恐怖。他与青沼英二认为这一设计可能偏离了希望保留的原版体验，因此决定减弱其恐怖程度。不过，不少玩家仍觉得重制版中的ReDead十分吓人。

paragraphs.en: Producer Hidemaro Fujibayashi explained why the development team behind the Ocarina of Time Remake toned down the ReDeads to make them less scary.
paragraphs.cn: 制作人藤林秀麿解释了《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版开发团队为何对ReDead进行了弱化，让它们不那么恐怖。

paragraphs.en: If you grew up playing the original Ocarina of Time on the Nintendo 64, you were probably traumatized by some of the game’s famously frightening enemies like the Gibdos, ReDeads, and Dead Hands. These last two were particularly terrifying for young players at the time — partially because we were still kids, and partially due to the N64’s graphical limitations that forced our minds to fill in the visual gaps in the monsters’ designs.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你是玩着任天堂64上的初代《塞尔达传说 时之笛》长大的，你可能曾被游戏中一些出了名的恐怖敌人吓出心理阴影，比如Gibdo、ReDead和Dead Hand。后两者对当时年幼的玩家来说尤其可怕——一部分原因是我们那时还是孩子，另一部分则是N64的画面限制迫使我们用想象力补全怪物设计中的视觉空白。

paragraphs.en: These enemies were a particular talking point when the Remake was first announced. Some players were doubtful that this new game could truly capture the terror of the original monsters, since a) it’s a game that’s also supposed to appeal to children and b) the updated graphics of modern Nintendo consoles don’t necessarily allow for the ‘fear of the unknown’ phenomena afforded to low-fidelity titles like 1999's Silent Hill . (There’s an entire genre of indie horror games that pursue this aesthetic for a reason, after all.)
paragraphs.cn: 重制版最初公布时，这些敌人尤其引人议论。一些玩家怀疑这款新游戏能否真正再现原版怪物的恐怖之处，因为一是这款游戏还需要吸引儿童，二是任天堂现代主机升级后的画面不一定能带来1999年的《寂静岭》等低保真作品所具有的「对未知的恐惧」。（毕竟，有一整个类型的独立恐怖游戏都在追求这种美学，是有原因的。）

paragraphs.en: Speaking with Gamespot , producer Hidemaro Fujibayashi explained that the Remake’s updated graphics actually made the ReDeads extremely scary at first. And while the development team was supposedly enthusiastic about this aspect of the project, he and fellow producer Eiji Aonuma felt that this detail wasn’t necessarily true to the original experience of the first game.
paragraphs.cn: 制作人藤林秀麿在接受Gamespot采访时解释说，重制版升级后的画面实际上让ReDead起初变得极其恐怖。据说开发团队对项目的这一方面很有热情，但他和另一位制作人青沼英二认为，这一细节不一定忠于初代游戏最初的体验。

paragraphs.en: "With this remake, the graphics are a lot improved, and so the ReDead – the sound, the graphics, and the movement – ended up being very, very scary,” Fujibayashi said. “And the staff wanted to make this in service of making a good gameplay experience. But from our perspective, taking a step back, we felt like, ‘Let's remember the experience that we don't want to change, and taking that into consideration, maybe we've gone a step too far, so let's dial it back.’"
paragraphs.cn: 藤林秀麿说：「这次重制版的画面进步很大，所以ReDead的声音、画面和动作最终变得非常、非常吓人。工作人员希望这样做，以打造良好的游戏体验。但从我们的角度退一步来看，我们觉得：『让我们记住那些不想改变的体验，考虑到这一点，也许我们做得有些过头了，所以还是收敛一点吧。』」

paragraphs.en: That being said, plenty of players feel that the Remake’s ReDeads are still sufficiently terrifying. Social media is rife with hilarious reactions from fans’ first encounters with the enemies, with both Western and Japanese players having a “nope, f**k this,” mentality after first coming across them in the game.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，仍有不少玩家觉得重制版中的ReDead已经足够恐怖。社交媒体上到处都是粉丝首次遭遇这些敌人时的滑稽反应，西方和日本玩家在游戏中第一次碰到它们后，都抱着「不行，去他妈的」的心态。

paragraphs.en: Others are hopeful that, should other Zelda remakes get produced, Nintendo makes its other enemies equally scary — especially since these new ReDeads are far more mobile than their predecessors.
paragraphs.cn: 另一些人希望，如果制作其他《塞尔达传说》重制版，任天堂能让其中的其他敌人同样恐怖——尤其是因为这些新的ReDead比它们之前的版本灵活得多。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake has, perhaps unsurprisingly, proven to be a smash hit for Nintendo; the game sold over five million copies in just four days and released to rave reviews from both fans and critics. IGN’s Logan Plant scored the title a glowing 9 out of 10 , praising it for “skillfully melding the world and dungeon design of classic Zeldas with the movement and presentation of its more recent games, creating both a beautiful retelling of a legend and a rich adventure that stands on its own.”
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版已被证明是任天堂的一款大热作品，这或许并不令人意外；游戏仅用四天就售出超过500万份，发售后获得了粉丝和评论家的高度评价。IGN的Logan Plant给这款游戏打出了好评如潮的9分（满分10分），称赞它「巧妙地将经典《塞尔达传说》作品的世界和地牢设计与系列近期游戏的移动方式及呈现形式融合在一起，既创造了一段对传奇的精彩重述，也带来了一场能够独立成立的丰富冒险」。
